description: Oversold-bounce scenario: 14 consecutive losses drive RSI to 0 (oversold), then 5 rising candles demonstrate recovery. First RSI = 0 (pure-loss seed). After recovery candles RSI climbs above 30, confirming the primitive captures a realistic oversold-then-recover pattern. All values in [0,100].

expectedOutput.note: First value MUST be exactly 0 (pure-loss seed, avgGain=0). Values after index 0 reflect Wilder smoothing as gains appear.
